title: Cowboy Messiah
description: A glowing cowboy figure stands in the center wearing a white hat and flowing pastel robes, holding a luminous cross staff aloft. Rain falls from the sky as doves fly around him against a radiant golden halo and dreamy pastel clouds.
prompt: A luminous cowboy wearing a white hat and long flowing robes in pastel green, blue and purple stands in the rain, holding a glowing golden cross staff high with one hand. He has a bright radiant halo behind his head. Doves fly around him in a dreamy sky filled with soft clouds and golden light, ethereal watercolor painting with delicate ribbons and rain streaks
